mapper.insert: INSERT INTO arrival_confirmation ( entry_record_id, resume_id, source_recruitment_request_id, candidate_name, supplier_id, supplier_name, supplier_hr_user_id, supplier_hr_user_name, target_org_unit_name, room_manager_user_id, room_manager_user_name, hr_team_manager_user_id, hr_team_manager_user_name, entry_date, position_level, approval_status, current_approval_level, create_time, create_user_id, create_user_name, update_time, update_user_id, update_user_name ) VALUES ( #{entryRecordId}, #{resumeId}, #{sourceRecruitmentRequestId}, #{candidateName}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{supplierHrUserId}, #{supplierHrUserName}, #{targetOrgUnitName}, #{roomManagerUserId}, #{roomManagerUserName}, #{hrTeamManagerUserId}, #{hrTeamManagerUserName}, #{entryDate}, #{positionLevel}, #{approvalStatus}, #{currentApprovalLevel}, #{createTime}, #{createUserId}, #{createUserName}, #{updateTime}, #{updateUserId}, #{updateUserName} )
mapper.update: UPDATE arrival_confirmation SET supplier_id = #{supplierId}, supplier_name = #{supplierName}, supplier_hr_user_id = #{supplierHrUserId}, supplier_hr_user_name = #{supplierHrUserName}, target_org_unit_name = #{targetOrgUnitName}, room_manager_user_id = #{roomManagerUserId}, room_manager_user_name = #{roomManagerUserName}, hr_team_manager_user_id = #{hrTeamManagerUserId}, hr_team_manager_user_name = #{hrTeamManagerUserName}, entry_date = #{entryDate}, position_level = #{positionLevel}, approval_status = #{approvalStatus}, current_approval_level = #{currentApprovalLevel}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user_id = #{updateUserId}, update_user_name = #{updateUserName} WHERE arrival_confirmation_id = #{arrivalConfirmationId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM arrival_confirmation WHERE entry_record_id = #{entryRecordId} ORDER BY update_time DESC, arrival_confirmation_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM arrival_confirmation ORDER BY update_time DESC, arrival_confirmation_id DESC
SELECT * FROM arrival_confirmation WHERE create_user_id = #{createUserId} ORDER BY update_time DESC, arrival_confirmation_id DESC
